basic_info.description: 2 bedroom, 2 bath condo, at Candlestick Cove. Bay views, 2 full baths, gourmet kitchen with breakfast bar, open to living area. Private balcony, en-suite bath and walk-in closet in master suite. Washer and dryer in unit, and one car parking included in rent.
